mnemonic.meaning: 貸 lend: what you lent out.
mnemonic.reading: "KASHI!" (かし) Cash he owes you. Same sound as 菓子 (sweets).

examples.ja: 彼には一つ貸しがある。
examples.en: He owes me one.

items.note: Opposite of 借り (Level 17). 貸し出し = lending out (library).

mnemonic.meaning: 刈 has 刂 (knife): cutting with a blade.
mnemonic.reading: "KARU!" (かる) Same sound as 狩る (hunt).

examples.ja: 庭の草を刈った。
examples.en: I mowed the grass in the garden.

items.note: Godan: 刈った. For grass, hair, crops. 髪を刈る = cut hair short.

mnemonic.meaning: BATTARI: "Bump-tari!" You bump right into someone.

examples.ja: 駅で先生にばったり会った。
examples.en: I ran into my teacher at the station.

items.note: Usually ばったり会う (run into someone). Also falling with a thud.

mnemonic.meaning: 脂 fat + 肪 fat: fat.
mnemonic.reading: "SHE, BOU!" (しぼう) She bows to the fat cat. Same sound as 死亡 (death) and 志望 (aspiration).

examples.ja: 脂肪の少ない肉を選んだ。
examples.en: I chose lean meat.

items.note: 体脂肪 = body fat. 脂 (Level 21) is grease.

mnemonic.meaning: 福 has 礻 (altar): blessings from the gods.
mnemonic.reading: "FUKU!" (ふく) Same sound as 服 (clothes).

examples.ja: 笑う門には福来る。
examples.en: Fortune comes to a merry home.

items.note: 幸福 = happiness. 福袋 = lucky bag sold at New Year.

mnemonic.meaning: 焚 = 林 (woods) over 火 (fire): burning wood.
mnemonic.reading: "TAKU!" (たく) Same sound as 炊く (cook rice).

examples.ja: キャンプで火を焚いた。
examples.en: We made a fire at the campsite.

items.note: Burning wood or incense: 線香を焚く. 焚き火 = bonfire.

mnemonic.meaning: 記 record + 入 enter: entering a record.
mnemonic.reading: "KEE, NYUU!" (きにゅう) Key in your new info.

examples.ja: この用紙に名前を記入してください。
examples.en: Please write your name on this form.

items.note: For forms and documents. 書き込む is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 小 small + 銭 coin: small coins.
mnemonic.reading: "KO, ZENI!" (こぜに) Small money. Note: 銭 is ぜに here.

examples.ja: 小銭がなくて、バスに乗れなかった。
examples.en: I had no change, so I couldn't take the bus.

items.note: 小銭入れ = coin purse.

mnemonic.meaning: 食 food + 品 goods: food goods.
mnemonic.reading: "SHOKU, HIN!" (しょくひん) Shocked by the food products.

examples.ja: 食品売り場は地下にある。
examples.en: The food section is in the basement.

items.note: Food as a product: 冷凍食品 (frozen food), 食品会社.

mnemonic.meaning: 僧 = 亻 (person) + 曽: a person of the temple.
mnemonic.reading: "SOU!" (そう) So, the monk says.

examples.ja: 寺には若い僧が住んでいる。
examples.en: A young monk lives at the temple.

items.note: お坊さん is the everyday, friendly word.

mnemonic.meaning: 炊 = 火 (fire) + 欠: cooking over a fire.
mnemonic.reading: "TAKU!" (たく) Same sound as 焚く.

examples.ja: 毎朝ご飯を炊く。
examples.en: I cook rice every morning.

items.note: Mainly for rice. 炊飯器 = rice cooker. In Kansai also for simmering: 炊いたん.

mnemonic.meaning: 郡 has 阝 (village): a group of villages.
mnemonic.reading: "GUN!" (ぐん) Same sound as 軍 (army) and 群.

examples.ja: 祖母は長野県の木曽郡に住んでいる。
examples.en: My grandmother lives in Kiso District, Nagano Prefecture.

items.note: In addresses: 〜郡〜町.

mnemonic.meaning: 欠 lack + 陥 defect: something lacking.
mnemonic.reading: "KEK, KAN!" (けっかん) Same sound as 血管 (blood vessel).

examples.ja: この車にはブレーキに欠陥があった。
examples.en: This car had a defect in its brakes.

items.note: Serious faults in products or systems. 欠点 is a weak point.

mnemonic.meaning: 公 public + 演 perform: a public performance.
mnemonic.reading: "KOU, EN!" (こうえん) Same sound as 公園 (park) and 講演 (lecture).

examples.ja: 劇団の公演を見に行った。
examples.en: I went to see the theatre company's performance.

items.note: Plays, concerts, dance. 講演 (also こうえん) is a lecture.

mnemonic.meaning: 勘 check + 定 fix: checking and fixing the total.
mnemonic.reading: "KAN, JOU!" (かんじょう) Same sound as 感情 (emotion).

examples.ja: お勘定をお願いします。
examples.en: The bill, please.

items.note: Old-fashioned for the bill; お会計 (Level 21) is more common now. 勘定に入れる = take into account.

mnemonic.meaning: 及 reach: making an effect reach something.
mnemonic.reading: "OYOBOSU!" (およぼす) Oh, you, boss, your influence reaches us.

examples.ja: タバコは健康に悪い影響を及ぼす。
examples.en: Smoking has a bad effect on your health.

items.note: Almost always 影響を及ぼす / 被害を及ぼす. Formal.

mnemonic.meaning: 依 depend + 然 state: the state still depends on the past.
mnemonic.reading: "EE, ZEN!" (いぜん) Same sound as 以前 (before).

examples.ja: 問題は依然として解決されていない。
examples.en: The problem still hasn't been solved.

items.note: Usually 依然として. Formal; まだ is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 免 permit + 許 permit: permission granted.
mnemonic.reading: "MEN, KYO!" (めんきょ) Men from Kyoto get a licence.

examples.ja: 車の免許を取った。
examples.en: I got my driver's licence.

items.note: 運転免許 = driver's licence. 免許証 = the card itself.

mnemonic.meaning: 税 has 禾 (grain): grain paid as tax.
mnemonic.reading: "ZEI!" (ぜい) Zay, pay your tax.

examples.ja: この値段は税込みです。
examples.en: This price includes tax.

items.note: 税金 = tax money. 消費税 = consumption tax. 税込み / 税抜き = incl. / excl. tax.

mnemonic.meaning: 東 east + 洋 ocean: the eastern seas.
mnemonic.reading: "TOU, YOU!" (とうよう) Toe to you from the East.

examples.ja: 東洋の文化に興味がある。
examples.en: I'm interested in Eastern culture.

items.note: Opposite: 西洋 (せいよう, the West).

mnemonic.meaning: 添 has 氵: water flowing alongside. Staying close.
mnemonic.reading: "SOU!" (そう) Same sound as 沿う (along).

examples.ja: ご期待に添えるよう頑張ります。
examples.en: I'll do my best to meet your expectations.

items.note: Formal: 期待に添う. 寄り添う = to snuggle up, stay close.

mnemonic.meaning: 弱 weak: make it weaker.
mnemonic.reading: "YOWA, MERU!" (よわめる) Weak mail.

examples.ja: 火を弱めてください。
examples.en: Please turn down the heat.

items.note: Transitive partner of 弱まる (Level 17).

mnemonic.meaning: 近 near + 代 age: the age near to now.
mnemonic.reading: "KIN, DAI!" (きんだい) Kin of the modern era.

examples.ja: 近代の日本は急速に発展した。
examples.en: Modern Japan developed rapidly.

items.note: In Japanese history, roughly Meiji to WWII. 現代 (Level 11) is the present day.

mnemonic.meaning: 絶 cut off + 滅 destroy: cut off and destroyed.
mnemonic.reading: "ZETSU, METSU!" (ぜつめつ) Zero mates left: extinct.

examples.ja: この鳥は絶滅しそうだ。
examples.en: This bird is close to extinction.

items.note: 絶滅危惧種 = endangered species.

mnemonic.meaning: 不 not + 平 calm: not calm. A complaint.
mnemonic.reading: "FOO, HEY!" (ふへい) Foo, hey, I'm not happy.

examples.ja: 彼は不平ばかり言っている。
examples.en: He does nothing but complain.

items.note: 不平を言う = to complain. 不満 (Level 3) is the feeling; 不平 is voicing it.

mnemonic.meaning: 勤 has 力 (power): putting power into work.
mnemonic.reading: "TSUTOME!" (つとめ) Same sound as 務め (Level 16).

examples.ja: 父の勤め先は銀行だ。
examples.en: My father works at a bank.

items.note: Employment: 勤め先 (workplace), 会社勤め (office job).

mnemonic.meaning: 定 fixed + 期 period: a fixed period.
mnemonic.reading: "TAY, KEY!" (ていき) The key to a regular routine.

examples.ja: 定期的に歯医者に行っている。
examples.en: I go to the dentist regularly.

items.note: 定期券 = commuter pass, often just 定期. 定期的 = regular.

mnemonic.meaning: 反 against: bending against its shape.
mnemonic.reading: "SORU!" (そる) Same sound as 剃る (shave).

examples.ja: 板が湿気で反ってしまった。
examples.en: The board warped from the humidity.

items.note: Godan: 反った. Also leaning back: 体を反らす.

mnemonic.meaning: 国 country + 語 language: the country's language.
mnemonic.reading: "KOKU, GO!" (こくご) Go to Japanese class.

examples.ja: 国語の授業で作文を書いた。
examples.en: I wrote an essay in Japanese class.

items.note: In Japanese schools, 国語 is the Japanese-language subject.

mnemonic.meaning: 射 = 身 (body) + 寸 (hand): a body aiming with the hand. Light shooting in.
mnemonic.reading: "SASU!" (さす) Same sound as 刺す (stab) and 指す (point).

examples.ja: 窓から朝日が射している。
examples.en: The morning sun is shining in through the window.

items.note: For light; often written 差す. 日が差す = the sun shines.
